knowledge.title: Knowledge
knowledge.intro: Collections make your documents searchable in chat. Your files stay where they are – LocalDesk only keeps passages and their fingerprints.
knowledge.name: Name
knowledge.sourcesHint: Folders are read including subfolders (except node_modules, .git, dist …). PDF and Word (.docx) up to 50 MB, text, Markdown and source code up to 2 MB per file. Scanned PDFs without text don't work.
knowledge.confirmDelete: Delete collection “{{name}}”? Your files stay untouched – only the indexed passages are removed.
knowledge.aborted: Indexing cancelled – what is done stays, the rest follows next time.
knowledge.modelMissing: The embedding model {{model}} is not installed on the active Ollama server. Download it under “Installed models”.
knowledge.obsidianManaged: This collection is your Obsidian vault. LocalDesk creates it and keeps the folder up to date; front matter, tags and [[wiki links]] are prepared for search, “.obsidian” and your memories are skipped. To change or remove it:

status.loadedIntro: Ollama loads a model into memory at the first chat and unloads it after a while without requests (default: 5 minutes). The size depends heavily on the context length.
status.noneLoaded: No model is loaded right now. It shows up here as soon as you chat.
status.cpuWarning: Part of the model doesn't fit into graphics memory and runs on the processor – answers become much slower. Fixes: a smaller context length, a smaller model, or let other loaded models unload.

gpu.title: Graphics card
gpu.remote: LocalDesk can only measure the graphics card if the active Ollama server runs on this PC. For a server on your network, see below what Ollama itself reports.
gpu.noNvidia: No NVIDIA graphics card found (nvidia-smi is missing). The loaded models below still show how much VRAM Ollama uses.

shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
shortcuts.footer: In chat: Enter sends, Shift+Enter starts a new line.

folders.confirmDelete: Delete project “{{name}}”? The chats in it are kept and move to “No project”. Instructions and indexed project documents are removed – your files stay untouched.
folders.noneYet: No projects yet – create one with the folder icon above.

projects.name: Name
projects.confirmDelete: Delete project “{{name}}”? The chats in it are kept and move to “No project”. Instructions and indexed project documents are removed – your files stay untouched.
projects.instructionsPlaceholder: e.g. “You are my statistics tutor. Explain step by step and ask when something is unclear.”
projects.instructionsHint: Apply to every chat in this project – before a chat's own system prompt. Saved as soon as you leave the field.
projects.documentsHint: Searched automatically in every chat of this project – in addition to collections a chat picks with the Knowledge button.
projects.noChats: No chats in this project yet.
projects.skillsHint: Apply in every chat of this project – in addition to the skills you turn on in the chat.

chat.title: Chat
chat.editSend: Send and get a new answer
chat.editHint: This and all following messages are replaced. Ctrl+Enter sends, Esc cancels.
chat.empty: Pick a model above and write a message.
chat.inputNoModel: No model available – is Ollama running?
chat.hint: Enter to send · Shift+Enter new line · Ctrl+/ all shortcuts

sidePanel.noSources: No sources yet – they appear here as soon as an answer has used knowledge.
sidePanel.sourcesOf: Passages the model received from your knowledge for the last answer.
sidePanel.noProject: This chat doesn't belong to a project. Drag it into a project in the chat list so its instructions and documents apply.
sidePanel.estimateHint: Estimated for the next request (without your new message) – only Ollama counts exactly.

level.tight: Little room is left for the answer – it might stop mid-sentence.
level.full: No longer fits: Ollama then drops the beginning of the history and the model “forgets” it.

sidePanel.vramTooMuch: Only {{free}} is free right now – part of the model would then run on the CPU (slower).
sidePanel.vramUnknown: How much extra graphics memory this needs can't be estimated in advance for this model.
sidePanel.atMaximum: The model can't handle a longer context. Start a new chat or add less knowledge/tools.
sidePanel.probablyCut: That hit the limit – something was probably cut off.

sources.none: No matching passages found in your knowledge – the answer comes from the model itself.

toolCall.askDestructive: This tool can change or overwrite files.
toolCall.allowAlwaysHint: Applies to this tool on this server, in other chats too. Change it under Settings → MCP servers.
toolCall.memoryAsk: The model wants to remember something about you

downloads.hint: You can find names in the Ollama library:
downloads.invalidName: That isn't a valid model name (e.g. “qwen3:8b” or “nomic-embed-text”).

models.title: Installed models
models.empty: No models installed. Download one above, e.g. “qwen3:8b”.
models.confirmDelete:
Delete model “{{name}}” ({{size}}) from disk permanently?

To use it again later it has to be downloaded again. Your chats with this model are kept.

mcp.title: MCP servers
mcp.intro: MCP servers give models tools – for example reading files. Each server is its own program that runs on this PC with your permissions. The file-system server only sees the folders you share here.
mcp.name: Name
mcp.foldersHint: Only these folders (including subfolders) are reachable. A whole drive is not allowed.
mcp.confirmDelete: Delete MCP server “{{name}}”? Files in the folders are left alone.
mcp.startingHint: Starting … The very first time, npx downloads the server, which can take up to a minute.
mcp.permissionHint: Always = runs without asking · Ask = you confirm every call in the chat · Off = the model isn't offered the tool at all.
mcp.confirmAlways: “{{name}}” can overwrite or move files. Really allow it without asking?

servers.title: Ollama servers
servers.intro: Which Ollama server LocalDesk talks to. Switching applies immediately to status, models and new answers.
servers.name: Name
servers.addressHint: IP address or computer name, e.g. 192.168.1.20 – without a port, 11434 is assumed.
servers.lanHelpTitle: What has to be set up on the other computer?
servers.lanHelp1: Ollama must listen on the network: set the environment variable OLLAMA_HOST=0.0.0.0 and restart Ollama.
servers.lanHelp2: The Windows firewall there must allow incoming connections on port 11434 (private network only).
servers.lanHelp3: Enter that computer's IP address here and check it with “Test”. Note: LocalDesk can only show GPU load for a server on this PC.
servers.lanHelp4: For security, LocalDesk asks before every tool when the server is on another computer – even when reading mail or files. The server gets to see every result.

memories.intro: Facts about you that every model knows – each one a note in the vault (editable in Obsidian). Project memories only apply in chats of that project.
memories.placeholder: New memory, e.g. “I'm studying statistics in my 3rd semester.”
memories.confirmDelete: Delete memory “{{text}}”? The note is removed from the vault.
memories.rememberTitle: Save as a memory – shorten the text to the fact
memories.rememberHint: Save a fact from this message as a memory

obsidian.title: Obsidian
obsidian.intro: For memories, saved chats and summaries. LocalDesk reads the whole vault (for example as knowledge) but writes only into its own subfolder.
obsidian.vaultHint: The folder you opened as a vault in Obsidian (it contains a “.obsidian” folder).
obsidian.folderHint: LocalDesk creates notes only here. It is created the first time something is saved.
obsidian.noObsidianFolder: No “.obsidian” folder found – is this really an Obsidian vault? You can still use it.
obsidian.confirmRemove: Stop using this vault? Nothing is deleted in the vault – not even LocalDesk's notes. The “Obsidian” collection (only the indexed data) is removed.
obsidian.knowledgeNew: Usable as knowledge through the “Obsidian” collection – not indexed yet.
obsidian.knowledgeReady_one: Usable as knowledge: “Obsidian” collection with {{count}} file.
obsidian.knowledgeReady_other: Usable as knowledge: “Obsidian” collection with {{count}} files.

settings.title: Settings
settings.licensesIntro: LocalDesk is released under the MIT License. It ships packages by other authors – their licenses are listed here.
settings.licensesMissing: The license files were not found.

templates.title: Templates
templates.intro: Templates store model, system prompt and parameters for recurring tasks – e.g. “Python tutor” or “Summarize texts”. Pick one on the left or create a new one.
templates.name: Name
templates.modelHint: Without a fixed model, the chat keeps whatever model is currently selected.
templates.modelMissing: This model is not (or no longer) installed. The chat then keeps the currently selected model.
templates.confirmDelete: Delete template “{{name}}”? Existing chats stay unchanged.
templates.collectionsHint: Which collections a chat with this template searches before every answer. Can be changed later in the chat with the Knowledge button.
templates.mcpServersHint: Which tools a chat with this template may use. Can be changed later in the chat with the MCP button.
templates.skillsHint: Apply in every chat that starts with this template.
templates.noneHint: Templates let you start chats with a fixed model, system prompt and parameters.

mcpPicker.title: MCP servers for this chat
mcpPicker.intro: Only the selected servers offer their tools to this chat. Permissions per tool are under Settings.
mcpPicker.none: No MCP servers set up yet.
mcpPicker.modelNoTools: According to Ollama, the selected model can't use tools – choose e.g. qwen3, gpt-oss or gemma4.

knowledgePicker.title: Knowledge for this chat
knowledgePicker.intro: Before every answer, LocalDesk searches the selected collections and gives the model matching passages.

settingsPanel.title: Chat settings
settingsPanel.systemPromptPlaceholder: e.g. “You are a patient Python tutor. Explain step by step.”
settingsPanel.systemPromptHint: A fixed instruction the model gets before every message.
settingsPanel.contextHint: How much of the history the model sees. More context needs more VRAM.
settingsPanel.contextHintMax: How much of the history the model sees – this model handles up to {{max}}. More context needs more VRAM; if it no longer fits on the GPU, it gets much slower.
settingsPanel.temperatureHint: 0 = factual and repeatable, from 1 up = more creative and varied.
settingsPanel.seedHint: Same seed + same question = same answer. Handy for comparing.
settingsPanel.thinkHint: Off = faster answers without a thoughts section.
settingsPanel.thinkHintLevels: This model has no “off”, only levels. Low = shorter and faster.
settingsPanel.footer: Applies from the next message and is saved with the chat.

chatNote.saveChat: Save the whole chat to Obsidian
chatNote.saveAnswer: Save this answer with its question as a note in Obsidian

summary.title: Summary
summary.button: Summarize chat and save to Obsidian
summary.suggestText: This chat has been idle. {{model}} can summarize it – you see the draft before anything lands in Obsidian.

update.dev: Updates only exist in the installed app (not in development mode).
update.checking: Looking for a new version on GitHub …
update.dataSafe: Your chats, settings and notes are kept during the update.
update.ready: Version {{version}} has been downloaded and verified.
update.restartHint: On restart it is installed in the existing folder; LocalDesk then starts again by itself.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.intro: Light, dark or automatic like Windows (Settings → Personalization → Colors).
appearance.languageIntro: The language of the interface. “Like Windows” uses German on a German Windows and English otherwise.

skills.title: Skills
skills.reload: Reload all (after changes outside the app)
skills.openSkillFolder: Open this skill's folder in Explorer
skills.confirmDelete: Delete skill “{{name}}”? Its SKILL.md is removed.
skills.name: Name
skills.descriptionHint: The model uses this to decide whether to load the skill itself – describe the task and the trigger, e.g. “when the user shows code and wants it reviewed”.
skills.descriptionPlaceholder: Checks code for errors … – when the user …
skills.bodyHint: {{count}} / {{max}} characters. That is how much context the skill costs when it is turned on.
skills.intro: Skills are instructions for recurring tasks – e.g. how the model should summarize, review code or answer mail. You turn them on in the chat, or the model loads a fitting one itself.
skills.introSafe: A skill is only text: it runs nothing and grants no tool permissions.

skillPicker.title: Skills
skillPicker.intro: Skills that are turned on apply to every answer in this chat – their text costs context accordingly.

mailSettings.title: E-mail
mailSettings.intro: LocalDesk reads your mail directly from Google – through your own app that you create there. There is no sending or deleting; LocalDesk changes labels and stars only after you confirm.
mailSettings.guide: Step by step (German): docs/email-einrichten.md in the LocalDesk folder.
mailSettings.clientIdHint: From the Google Cloud Console → Clients → Desktop app. Ends in “.apps.googleusercontent.com”.
mailSettings.clientSecretHint: Right next to the client ID. Stays in LocalDesk and is not shown here again.
mailSettings.confirmRemove: Remove the Google app from LocalDesk? It stays in place at Google.
mailSettings.outlookLater: Outlook comes later – Microsoft requires its own Azure directory for it.
mailSettings.waiting: Your browser is open – sign in there and allow access. On “App not verified”: Advanced → Go to LocalDesk.
mailSettings.confirmDisconnect: Sign out {{email}}? LocalDesk revokes the access at Google and forgets the sign-in.
mailSettings.revokeFailed: Signed out locally, but Google couldn't be reached. To be safe, remove the access at myaccount.google.com/permissions.
mailSettings.lockedHint: You can change or remove it only after all accounts are signed out.
mailSettings.encrypted: The sign-in is stored encrypted with Windows.

mail.title: E-mail
mail.searchHint: Gmail search, e.g. “is:unread” or “from:bank”. Enter searches, empty = inbox.
mail.noSelection: Pick a mail on the left.
mail.noSelectionHint: LocalDesk shows mail as text only, without images from the internet. Nothing is marked as read, sent or deleted.
mail.setupText: First sign in with your Google account in Settings.
mail.reauth: Go to Settings and sign in again
mail.truncated: This mail is very long – only the beginning is shown.
mail.summaryHint: Created by {{model}} on this PC – it may contain mistakes.

mailSort.title: Suggest sorting
mailSort.intro_one: The model sees sender, subject and preview of the first mail in the list and suggests your own labels and stars. In Gmail, only what you tick and apply changes.
mailSort.intro_other: The model sees sender, subject and preview of the first {{count}} mails in the list and suggests your own labels and stars. In Gmail, only what you tick and apply changes.
mailSort.noLabels: You have no labels of your own in Gmail yet – so the model can only suggest stars. You create labels in Gmail.
mailSort.running_one: The model is looking at 1 mail …
mailSort.running_other: The model is looking at {{count}} mails …
mailSort.none: No suggestions – the model sees nothing that clearly fits a label or star.
mailSort.byModel: Suggestions from {{model}} – check them before you apply them.

mailChat.button: E-mail: use your mailbox in chat
mailChat.title: E-mail in chat
mailChat.intro: In this chat the model may search and read mail. It only suggests labels and stars – you confirm every change. There is no sending or deleting.
mailChat.none: No mail account signed in yet.
mailChat.noTools: The selected model can't use tools – choose one with “Tools” so it can read mail.

code.title: Code
code.confirmDelete: Delete session “{{name}}”? The history with the agent is removed – your files stay untouched.
code.intro: Pick a project folder with “New session”. The agent works only in that folder.
code.introSafe: Reading needs no approval. Changing files, running commands and commits only happen after your approval – with a before/after view and “Undo”. There is no push.
code.tooLarge: The file is larger than 1 MB – it isn't shown.
code.binary: Not a text file – it isn't shown.
code.agentEmpty: What should the agent do in this project?
code.agentHint: For example: “Explain the structure”, “Where is X calculated?”. It only sees this folder; it reads files without asking.
code.noToolModels: No installed model can use tools – the agent needs one (e.g. qwen3, gpt-oss).

mode.title: Agent working mode
mode.manualHint: Every change, command and commit is confirmed one by one.
mode.planHint: The agent only reads and writes a plan. Nothing is changed until you approve it.

plan.ready: In plan mode the agent changed nothing. Does the plan look right?
plan.executeHint: Switches to “Ask each time” – you still confirm every change one by one.
plan.executeMessage: The plan is approved. Now carry it out step by step and change only what the plan says.

code.undoConflict: {{error}} Reset to the state before the change anyway? Later changes to the file will be lost.

access.askMail: The model wants to use your mailbox
access.askFiles: The model wants to access files
access.mailHint: The model may search and read mail. Changing anything (label, star) still needs your confirmation.
access.filesHint: Reading runs right away. Writing and overwriting still ask on every call.
access.nothing: There is nothing that could be shared – set it up in Settings.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.intro: No telemetry, no account, no ads. Your data stays on this PC and only goes to the Ollama server you set.
privacy.missing: The privacy policy was not found.
